# Astronomical 0.2.61
Astronomical Stable v0.2.61 ships new user-facing capabilities and model catalog updates.
## What is new
- **Respond with images.** `astronomical respond PROMPT --image PATH` is repeatable and attaches raster images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) to the prompt so it can drive vision models. Unsupported, missing, or oversized inputs fail with a clear message. - **Thin Talk.** In-app HTML/TypeScript conversation with a sidebar and sessions. - **Model catalog.** Added Qwen3.8 35B A3B Distill 4-bit; removed Qwen 3.8 35B A3B Distill oQ6e MTP 6-bit. - **Menu.** Reports expert memory mode at worker ready.
## Compatibility
macOS 14.0 and above, arm64. Existing libraries, conversations, and instance configuration are preserved; no migration is required.
## Distribution
Distributed as a Developer-ID-signed, Hardened Runtime, notarized DMG. Automatic updates are delivered through a Sparkle signed feed.
